english.title: Paying for the sexual services of a boy aged 16 / 17 - SOA 2003
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obtained for yourself the sexual services of a boy aged

(A)_[16,]_
(B)_[17,]_

whom you did not reasonably believe was aged 18 or over

(C)_[having previously made payment to him]_
(D)_[having previously promised to make payment to him]_
(E)_[having previously made payment to another person]_
(F)_[having previously promised to make payment to another person]_
(G)_[knowing that another person had previously made payment to him]_
(H)_[knowing that another person had previously promised to make payment to him]_
(I)_[knowing that another person had previously made payment to a third person]_
(J)_[knowing that another person had previously promised to make payment to a third person]_

for those services
english.legislation: Contrary to section 47(1)(a), (b), (c)(i) and (5) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence does NOT attract liability for entry on Sex Offenders Register as para 29 of Schedule 3 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003 provides only where the victim was under 16 years of age.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
